description: The ten pre-registered claims in Table 3 (the honesty ledger), each mapped to the committed, SHA-locked pre-registration that fixed it before scoring. The SHA-256 of each prereg_file is recorded in the companion prereg/SHA256_LOCK_*.json and is asserted from the committed bytes by scripts/prereg_manifest.py. Several claims share a workstream pre-registration that registers more than one sub-hypothesis. Where a finer per-claim seal exists, it is a *.sealed.json in the Zenodo deposit (not committed to this repository) and is referenced for provenance in the benchmark's metrics.json; the committed workstream pre-registration cited here is the object a reviewer can re-hash from a clone.
